skill.name: aippt
skill.description: Create customized PowerPoint decks from existing templates using image exports, content mapping, AI image generation, and PPTX packaging.
skill.summary: Generate image-based PPTX decks that preserve an existing template style.
skill.author: Ceeon

security_audit.summary: Most static backtick and entropy alerts are Markdown or CJK-text false positives. Confirmed risks remain for public image uploads, third-party image generation APIs, documented PowerShell execution, and local filesystem access in the PPTX packaging script. No prompt injection attempt was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Public image hosting can expose sensitive slide images.
remediation.suggestion: Add a clear warning before any upload step and support private, approved storage options for confidential decks.

remediation.issue: A concrete freeimage.host API key is embedded in upload commands.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the shared key and require users to provide their own credential through a private environment variable or local config file.

remediation.issue: Third-party generation APIs receive prompts and image references.
remediation.suggestion: Document the data sent to providers and require user confirmation before sending customer or proprietary content.

remediation.issue: Example credential handling uses local secrets documentation.
remediation.suggestion: Keep only placeholder examples in the repository and add guidance to exclude real secrets from version control.

remediation.issue: The packaging script reads user-provided directories and writes output files.
remediation.suggestion: Validate input and output paths, reject unsafe output names, and document that only intended image folders should be processed.

semantic_findings.title: Sensitive Slide Images Uploaded to Public Hosts
semantic_findings.description: The workflow tells users to upload local slide images to public or third-party image hosts before generation. Templates may contain proprietary branding, customer data, or unreleased content, so this creates a privacy and data disclosure risk.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documentation explicitly requires local images to be uploaded and labels some hosts as permanent. This is a clear contextual privacy risk beyond the raw URL patterns.

semantic_findings.title: Hardcoded Public Upload API Key in Documentation
semantic_findings.description: The freeimage.host upload command embeds a concrete API key in the URL. Even if intended as a sample key, published shared credentials can be abused, rate-limited, revoked, or associated with unintended uploads.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The key-like value is present directly in two upload commands. It is not just a placeholder such as API_KEY or your-api-key-here.

semantic_findings.title: Third-Party Image Generation Receives Prompts and Image URLs
semantic_findings.description: The skill sends prompts and image references to external image generation APIs. This can disclose presentation content and derived image URLs to providers outside the user workspace.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The API calls are explicit and include prompt fields and image-generation endpoints. The risk depends on user data sensitivity and provider policy, so confidence is high but not absolute.

content.user_title: Generate AI PowerPoint Decks from Templates
content.value_statement: Creating a polished deck from an existing template is slow when every slide must preserve style. AIPPT guides users through template export, content mapping, AI slide generation, and PPTX packaging.
actual_capabilities: Guides export of PowerPoint templates into slide images for visual reference.
Defines a method to analyze layouts, editable regions, and fixed design elements.
Splits source content into a page plan with slide types and page goals.
Maps content to template layouts and creates prompts for AI image generation.
Provides a Node.js script that packages generated slide images into a PPTX file.
limitations: It relies on third-party image hosting and image generation services for core image workflows.
It packages slides as full-slide images, not editable native PowerPoint objects.
Generated Chinese text and small typography may require manual review and regeneration.
Users must provide their own template, content, API credentials, and local dependencies.

use_cases.title: Adapt a Brand Template
use_cases.description: Turn campaign notes into a new deck while keeping the template colors, layout style, and visual language.

use_cases.title: Prepare Client Presentations
use_cases.description: Convert a structured brief into a page plan, mapped layouts, generation prompts, and image-based slides.

use_cases.title: Build Training Decks
use_cases.description: Create consistent training slides from long-form material and package generated images into one PPTX.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Template Deck
prompt_templates.prompt: Use AIPPT to create a slide plan from this content and this existing PPT template. Keep the original visual style and suggest the first workflow steps.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Template Layouts
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these exported template slide images. Identify reusable layouts, fixed regions, editable regions, and the best content types for each layout.

prompt_templates.title: Map Content to Slides
prompt_templates.prompt: Split this source content into presentation pages. For each page, choose a template layout or a creative page, then write the image generation prompt.

prompt_templates.title: Produce Final Deck Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a complete AIPPT production checklist for this project. Include image upload decisions, API generation steps, review points, and final PPTX packaging.

output_examples.input: A 1,800 word product launch brief and a company presentation template.
output_examples.output: A 14-slide plan with a cover, agenda, pain points, solution pages, proof points, timeline, and closing page.

output_examples.input: Exported template slide images from a branded sales deck.
output_examples.output: A layout library that lists cover, agenda, chapter, comparison, list, and closing layouts with fixed and editable regions.

output_examples.input: A folder of generated slide images ready for packaging.
output_examples.output: A 16:9 PPTX file where each generated image fills one slide in filename order.

best_practices: Remove confidential data from templates before uploading any slide image to external services.
Use low resolution tests first, then regenerate final images only after prompts and layout mapping are stable.
Review every generated slide for text accuracy, brand compliance, and unwanted watermarks before packaging.
anti_patterns: Do not upload confidential customer, financial, or unreleased product material to public image hosts.
Do not expect the final PPTX to contain editable text boxes, charts, or native PowerPoint shapes.
Do not skip template analysis, because weak layout mapping leads to inconsistent generated slides.

faq.question: Does this skill create editable PowerPoint slides?
faq.answer: No. It packages generated slide images into a PPTX, so slide contents are image based.

faq.question: Do I need an existing template?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow is designed to preserve the style of an existing PPT template.

faq.question: Can it generate Chinese presentation text?
faq.answer: It can guide prompts for Chinese text, but generated text must be reviewed carefully.

faq.question: Does it require external services?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented workflow uses image hosting and third-party image generation APIs.

faq.question: What files does the packaging script use?
faq.answer: The script reads image files from a user-provided folder and writes a PPTX output file.

faq.question: Is it suitable for confidential decks?
faq.answer: Only with strong safeguards. Remove sensitive data or use approved private hosting and generation services.
